## Purpose
"Frontend Regeneration Spec — Agentic AI Design Patterns Platform": a long specification for Lovable.ai (or any AI frontend generator) to rebuild the whole frontend with the same functionality and API wiring and a better visual language. Its sections cover the product, the backend architecture, every endpoint, payload, query parameter and SSE event, and the pages.

## Accuracy
- **It is the brief `frontend-3` was generated from,** so it was accurate as of its last change (2026-08-24).
- **The backend has since grown** (accounts and admin, the vault, background runs, process knowledge, remote-server accounts, attachments and more), so it is incomplete for the current API.
- **`frontend-3`'s source and its replication docs are now the authority.**

## Used by
Lovable and frontend generators; historical reference.

## Replication notes
Keep it as history. To regenerate a frontend, update it from `frontend-3/src/api/*` first.
